title: Anthropic, Musk Offer Competing Visions for Sharing AI Wealth
text: Anthropic plans to dedicate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, offering its own approach to sharing the potential wealth created by AI as concerns grow about AI-driven labor disruption. Bloomberg’s Mike Shepard discusses how the plan differs from proposals for a government-run fund - and from Elon Musk’s pledge to give every child in America a share of SpaceX - as technology leaders confront a broader question: who should benefit financially from the AI boom? He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
